title: Enhanced photodynamic therapy of cancer using porphyrin-based nanoparticles synthesized via the co-precipitation method
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31539-31547
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04916D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Punnya Anil Kumar Jeeja, Atqiya Nafisa, Anh Nguyen, Abbe Eliasof, Audrey Berger, Paula Loman-Cortes, Juan L. Vivero-Escoto
This study presents the synthesis of porphyrin-based nanoparticles (PNPs) designed to improve PDT. In vitro experiments demonstrate superior cellular uptake and phototherapeutic performance of PNPs in cancer cell lines compared to porphyrins.
